title: Safety and emergencies
lead: When a guest is hurt, sick or choking: stay calm, act quickly, get the manager.

read.where: Occasionally an emergency will involve a customer: an **illness**, an **accident** or someone **choking**. You must **remain calm, act quickly** and follow these safety procedures, along with any **safety posters** in your restaurant.
read.visualIntro: A customer accident or injury, in order:

ask to keep it for the manager to review.
every crew member must know it.

read.where: Two more emergencies, with the same first steps: **show concern** and **get the manager on duty**.

stops.name: Foodborne illness or a foreign object
stops.text: Show concern for the customer, and **call for medical assistance** if they are experiencing distress. **Get the manager on duty immediately.** Ask whether they have the **suspicious object**, and request to keep it for the manager to review.

stops.name: Choking
stops.text: Give the **Heimlich maneuver** according to your restaurant’s **posted safety directions**. **Every crew member must be familiar with the Heimlich maneuver.**

sources: Hospitality 101 Training, page 5: Safety and emergencies.
